parameters.query:
SELECT 
    contract_id,
    contract_number,
    customer_name,
    service_type,
    end_date,
    monthly_amount,
    sales_rep_name,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (end_date - CURRENT_DATE))::INT AS days_remaining
FROM contracts 
WHERE status = 'active' 
  AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND end_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '90 days'
ORDER BY end_date ASC
LIMIT 10;
